messages:
Ravi (Docs): Hey team — i'm assembling the release note + short migration section for the embed routing refinement. want to lock copy and snippets before i open the PR.
Leah (Product): thanks. top points: default now favors latency, theres a deterministic mode, and small token-ordering quirk during cache warmup. keep it customer-facing and low-friction.
Kai (SDK): i'll prepare Python + TS examples. quick question: are we calling the flag `route_hint` or `routing_mode` now?
Tom (Engineering): the runtime landed `route_hint`. `routing_mode` was the old name. also note model alias changed: `embed-fast` -> `embed-lowlatency`. we'll add a note about redirects.
Ravi (Docs): great — i'll use `route_hint`. draft blurb idea: "Embed routing defaults to latency-optimized delivery. If you require deterministic ordering, set `route_hint: \"deterministic\"`."
Leah (Product): shorten it to one sentence and add effect: "may slightly increase latency". e.g., "...set `route_hint: \"deterministic\"` (may slightly increase latency)."
Kai (SDK): ok. i'll include a guard in examples: `# use deterministic for exact ordering` and mirror the same wording in SDK README.
Tom (Engineering): FYI we should surface the known issue: "First requests after cache cold-start can have minor token ordering differences." link to KB placeholder: https://kb.redwood.ai/000-placeholder
Ravi (Docs): adding that KB link placeholder; we'll replace when KB page exists. also adding a small "what changed" bullet: "Model alias rename: `embed-fast` -> `embed-lowlatency` (redirects in place)."
preview-bot: Docs preview ready: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-5234 (build 3) :white_check_mark:
Leah (Product): can we avoid multi-column example layout — it breaks on mobile. single-column snippets only.
Kai (SDK): yep — all snippets as standalone code blocks (no tables). also including a streaming example so users don't miss it.
Ravi (Docs): sample curl i'll include (compact): ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-lowlatency","route_hint":"latency","input":"hello world","stream":true}'
```
Tom (Engineering): add note that older clients hitting `embed-fast` will be 301-redirected; but we should recommend switching to `embed-lowlatency` explicitly for new deploys.
Ravi (Docs): checklist before merge: 1) SDK snippets (kai) 2) KB page draft (tom) 3) preview review and mobile sanity (leah) 4) add TOC anchor + known-issues section (ravi).
Leah (Product): timeline: want this live by COB Thursday. is that doable?
Tom (Engineering): we can publish runtime redirects by Wed, KB draft done Wed night.
Kai (SDK): i'll have snippets + README patch by Wed EOD.
Ravi (Docs): i'll open PR today and iterate. tagging reviewers: @Leah (Product) for copy + release timing, @Tom (Engineering) for KB/redirect confirmation.
Leah (Product): perfect. once live i'll post a short note in #announcements and cc support. :tada:
